Quick answers

Questions we hear every day

Still unsure? Message us — a real person replies during shop hours.

Do you really stock all brands?

Yes — Samsung, Redmi, realme, vivo, OPPO, OnePlus, Motorola, Nokia and more for mobiles; Samsung, LG, Voltas, Lloyd, Godrej, Whirlpool and Haier for appliances; Godrej Interio, Nilkamal, Durian, Sleepwell and Kurlon for furniture. If a brand is missing, tell us and we will arrange it.

Do you offer EMI and exchange?

Yes. Debit card, credit card and Bajaj Finserv EMI are available on TVs, ACs, refrigerators and furniture. We also value your old phone instantly and adjust it against a new purchase.

Do you deliver and install?

Free delivery within 15 km of Ganga on most purchases. TV wall-mounting and AC installation are handled by our own team, usually the same or next day.

Are the products covered by warranty?

Every item is brand-authorised and billed new with a manufacturer warranty. We help you register the warranty and follow up with the service centre if anything goes wrong.

Can I get the price on WhatsApp?

Yes. Send us the product name and we will reply with today’s best price, available colours and stock status — usually within minutes during shop hours.

Do you handle repairs and service?

Screen replacement, battery and charger issues, and brand service coordination are all handled at the counter. Bring the device in for a free check-up.
